footerFigure.countingRule: distinct adapter kinds granted on this pack, of 7 in the adapter catalog
footerFigure.renderedWhere: inline in the nav footer, immediately beside the number, not a tooltip and not an appendix
footerFigure.why: The old figure was the Connections register's '1 of 12 sources connected', a product-wide count of feed-integration build dispositions whose numerator is Esri mounted through the SmartSite embed. Esri is granted on no pack at all, so beside a city name that number was false for the city and was a figure without its denominator. What is true for the pack being viewed is how many adapter kinds are granted on it, which is zero on all three shipped packs.
invariants: numerator counts DISTINCT kinds, so two grants of one kind cannot push it past the denominator
numerator is intersected with the catalog, so a grant naming an uncatalogued kind cannot inflate it
unknownKinds and the raw grantCount travel in the payload beside the ratio, so the raw and distinct figures stay reconcilable instead of silently merged
footerFigure.productFigureDisposition: the register's 1 of 12 stays on the Connections page and gained its own inline counting rule, 'feeds table of this register, product wide', which it did not have before
footerFigure.collisionGuard: the two ratios use different verbs on purpose, granted in the footer and connected on Connections, so two adjacent numbers cannot be read as one class and reconciled to a single figure
